monitor.scope: Sampled direct PID RSS; OS peak and capacity were not measured.

server.scope: Direct owned native server was waited; group closure is parent-owned.

exclusive_sem_phases.reason: Native stage includes read, normalization and retention; the lazy WCC executes during its Parquet write. Exclusive Sem phases were not measured.

worker.scope: One unvalidated native WCC series on a shared host. Main continuous clock starts before input-read plans and ends at the last full write. Session setup, post-pipeline diagnostics, all validation, graph/session teardown and native process exit are outside that clock. Parent supplies source/input admission, physical output oracles and full process closure.

memory_admission.scope: Conservative O(V) array/workspace admission model, not measured RSS/OS peak or cap.

physical_oracle.scope: Full partition comparison to the sealed caller-supplied GF reference; reference engine provenance and waited producer closure are separate root proofs. No official Graphalytics topology/ground-truth or performance verdict.

environment.scope: Shared uncapped native host, n=1 per condition; no Sem resource/CSR-work parity. Exclusive four phases unavailable; observed spans are not a subtractive decomposition.
